title.orig: An Act Removing the Date of "Catarman Day" to August 30 of Every Year, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 9203, Entitiled "An Act Declaring the Fifteenth (15th) Day of August Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Camiguin, to be Known as "Catarman Day"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11182_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
- Section 1 of the Republic Act No. 9203 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. August 30 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Catarman, Province of Camiguin, to commemorate its foundation day anniversary, to be known as 'Catarman Day'."

- The Municipal Government of Catarman in the Province of Camiguin shall disseminate to oits component barangays , as well as to the Provincial Government of Camiguin, through means it deems proper and expedient, the change of the date of Catarman Day, for proper coordination of activities.
- The Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
